title: Fire Doors
activity: Fire door leaf, frame, gaps, seals, ironmongery and signage
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Certification label on top of the leaf present and undamaged?
Gaps 3 mm max and even (Kiwa limit 4 mm); threshold 6 mm max, or drop seal fitted on smoke doors?

guide.title: Fire door gaps – SJWS limits
rows: as tested: drop seal fitted (Lorient LAS8001 – approved)
flush in the frame when closed; pairs flush at meeting stiles
3 mm ±1 perimeter; 10 mm internal gap where specified
guide.note: Ask the fitter: 'What's the max gap and threshold gap for this door, and which seals does it take?' If they can't answer, flag it.
guide.src: Kiwa assessment PAR/25955/02 (SJWS-ESC-05-XX-TS-X-00067) – timber FD30/FD60; BS 8214:2016; Atlantic ITP 10.2; Block 5 benchmark BM-55

questions.q: Frame fixings the right number and position, frame-to-wall gap filled?
Frame-to-wall mastic at least 10 mm deep?
questions.source: Kiwa assessment PAR/25955/02 (SJWS-ESC-05-XX-TS-X-00067) – timber FD30/FD60 10.2; Atlantic ITP 10.2

questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Intumescent seals full length on all sides of door and frame, flush in their grooves?
Smoke seal fills the gap all round and engages fully when the door is shut?

questions.q: Latch engages securely with the keep; intumescent pads behind the lock and keep?
Hinges fixed with every screw (supplied fire-rated screws), intumescent pads behind each hinge?
Closer fixed with all its screws – door closes and latches from fully open and from 45°?
Other ironmongery (vision panels, grilles, letterplates) factory-fitted, glass/beads secure and undamaged?
Fire door signage fitted and secure?

notOk.t: Gaps over 4 mm (leaf/frame) or uneven top to bottom; threshold over 6 mm
Intumescent strip loose, painted over, cut or missing at corners
Door does not close and latch from fully open / rattles in the keep
Drop seal set too low (marks the floor) or not dropping
Frame-to-wall gap filled with foam or sealant less than 10 mm deep
Certification label painted over or removed
Ironmongery missing or fixed with wrong screws
Shadow gap above the frame uneven or poorly finished
